item.title: Show HN: Code Stitcher – Apply any LLM output to your local codebase
item.summary: Exactly what it seems. Arm the program, copy the code out in text or markdown and have it automatically apply to your local codebase. Includes python AST checking and now accepts all GDscript (GODOT) and associated files. https://github.com/ue-patcher/Code_Stitcher Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49446964 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
